neighbours.label: the comma after X in 'When you think of X,' (association framing)
fire: When you think of Paris, you probably picture the Eiffel Tower.
When you think of dice, chances are you picture six sides.
When people think of Halloween, they think of horror.
When one thinks of Louisiana, jazz often comes to mind.
When you think of American Express, credit cards come to mind.
When most people think of Italy, they think of pasta.
When you think of winter, what comes to mind?
When we think of Japan, we often think of sushi.
quiet: When I visited Paris, it rained every day.
When you roll dice, chances are you get a six eventually.
When people celebrate Halloween, they wear costumes.
When one drives through Louisiana, the roads are flat.
When you use American Express, you earn points.
When most people visit Italy, they eat pasta.
When winter arrives, the lake freezes.
When we travelled to Japan, we ate sushi.
